description: Create a card on the Editorial Board: a piece of content to curate, with an optional post URL (title/description/image are filled from the URL's metadata when omitted), assignee, priority, due date, category and column. Returns the card with its id. Use it to hand a trending post to a teammate instead of publishing it directly.

board_column_id.description: Target column (default: the board's default column).

card_type.description: Post, Note, Article, Video… (the org's card types).

platform.description: tiktok, instagram, x, facebook, pinterest, rss… (detected from post_url when omitted).

post_url.description: The post/article this card is about; metadata is fetched when title/image are missing.

title.description: Card title (required unless post_url is given).

name: viralhunt_create_card
